data.content_ref: inline:The 'refuted if' test is self-defeating: it states that UHI vanishing under high cloud cover would 'paradoxically support the shared radiative mechanism but refute the independence of the storage mechanism.' This concedes the relation still holds—both endpoints reduce to radiative cooling—so it does not specify what would refute the relation as stated. A predicate that, when triggered, confirms the relation cannot serve as a genuine refutation condition.
